name: SiteLabourTimesheetConsole
tagline: Crew timecards by cost code with automatic overtime, foreman approval and labour productivity – in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete site labour module for construction: one line per worker, day and cost code; straight time, overtime and double time from daily, weekly and weekend rules; fatigue-limit, overlap, missing-timecard, cost-code and quantity checks; foreman approval with reasons, locks and payroll batch references; a crew week grid; and earned-hours productivity by cost code and crew. Drop it on a canvas screen, model-driven form or Power Pages page and it works immediately with demo data, then connects to your timecard table in a few clicks.
features: ST / OT / DT split per worker (daily, weekly, weekend rules)
Labour cost with OT/DT multipliers and on-costs
Fatigue limit, overlapping times and missing timecards
Foreman approval workflow with reasons, locks and payroll batch
Bulk approve with skip of invalid lines, undo
Crew week grid with one-click approval
Earned hours and productivity factor by cost code and crew
